integrity: The group-theoretic and entropy arguments are explicit; the finite enumeration supplements but does not replace infinite-space proofs. Reference proofs of compact-group entropy addition and scalar linear entropy are explicitly identified.
scientific_limitations: Only continuous shift-equivariant group endomorphisms on the bilateral full shift over S3 x C2; counted rules may ignore allowed sites; joint entropy polynomial uses nonnegative consecutive sites. No assertions for arbitrary CAs or other dihedral groups. Historical priority provisional.
title: Exact entropy and reversibility census for twelve-element dihedral group cellular automata
